# Himanshu Sharma Portfolio - Premium React Website

## Project Overview
This is a premium personal portfolio website for Himanshu Sharma, a Senior Software Engineer & Technical Team Lead with 10+ years of experience. The website features modern glassmorphism design, 3D animations, and smooth interactions.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 with Vite
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom glassmorphism effects
- **Animations**: Framer Motion + GSAP
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js with React Three Fiber
- **Routing**: React Router DOM
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **SEO**: React Helmet Async

## Design System
- **Theme**: White background with neon blue accents (#00D4FF, #0EA5E9)
- **Typography**: Inter font family
- **Effects**: Glassmorphism, soft shadows, smooth gradients
- **Animation**: Scroll-triggered, hover effects, page transitions

## Project Structure
```
src/
├── components/     # Reusable UI components
├── sections/      # Page sections (Hero, About, Skills, etc.)
├── hooks/         # Custom React hooks
├── utils/         # Utility functions
└── assets/        # Static assets
```

## Development Guidelines
- Use Tailwind utility classes for styling
- Implement smooth animations with Framer Motion
- Ensure mobile-first responsive design
- Optimize performance with code splitting
- Follow React best practices and hooks

## Key Features
- Interactive 3D background elements
- Scroll-triggered animations
- Glassmorphism card designs
- Professional project showcase
- Smooth navigation and scrolling
- SEO optimized structure
